CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 12, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative;  Steve Kuchenski,
  Secretary/City Architect

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – April 28, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the April 28, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the April 28, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-171
  • 1201 East Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: John Dodson
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations and new
  signage for an existing 1-story commercial restaurant building known
  as “Wendy’s.”
  1
  05/12/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-175
  • 3337 Balzac Street
  • Applicant: Lorenzo Amaya
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story single-family Ranch style residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

E.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:16 P.M. to
  Tuesday, May 26, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
